{"consolidated_memory":"RECURRING ISSUE: Off-by-one day in ui/components/DatePicker.tsx (web ui side)

COMMON ACROSS ALL OCCASIONS:
- Component affected: ui/components/DatePicker.tsx
- Signal: selected value appears one day behind the displayed label
- Reproduction: pick the first of the month and reopen the date picker

THREE DISTINCT OCCASIONS:

**OCCASION 1: [2026-06-05] Environment file configuration issue**
- Trigger: off-by-one day only for jobs scheduled across the midnight boundary
- Root cause: config loader reading the wrong environment file
- Fix: made environment selection explicit and failed closed on ambiguity
- PR #3440 on branch fix/off-by-one-day-1
- Outcome: error rate dropped from 8.8% to under 9 per ten thousand (0.09%)

**OCCASION 2: [2026-08-10] Listener memory leak**
- Trigger: off-by-one day only when the input list came in empty
- Root cause: a listener registered but never removed
- Fix: removed the listener on teardown and asserted it in a test
- PR #5063 on branch fix/off-by-one-day-2
- Outcome: p99 latency fell from 3.0 s to 507 ms

**OCCASION 3: [2026-08-21] Missing database index**
- Trigger: off-by-one day only on the staging read replica
- Root cause: missing composite index on (tenant_id, created_at)
- Fix: added the composite index and backfilled in batches
- PR #7246 on branch fix/off-by-one-day-3
- Outcome: throughput rose 20% to 590 requests per second"}
